messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: Alert P99 streaming stalls > 2.5s in eu-west-2 for 8m. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Error class: downstream network timeouts. Pager duty: @Maya L.. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/alerts/2149876543 :rotating_light:
Maya L.: on it. paging chen and sam. any customer-facing impact yet?
Chen W.: seeing spike in TLS handshake latency and DNS lookup time from nodes in azb->azc. tcp retransmits up, packet loss ~0.6% on cross-zone path. nat ephem ports also trending up on gateway egress. suspect NAT + DNS fallback flapping.
Sam R.: confirming logs. p95 tokens latency up ~700ms, p99 > 2s. streaming stalls correlate with TLS SYN retries in traces. grabbing tcpdump from a few affected hosts now.
Sam R.: paste:
```
# tcpdump -nn -r sample.pcap | head
12:03:14.123456 IP 10.4.2.5.54321 > 10.8.1.10.443: Flags [S], seq 123456789, win 64240, options [mss 1460,sackOK,TS val 123456 ecr 0], length 0
12:03:14.223789 IP 10.4.2.5.54321 > 10.8.1.10.443: Flags [S], seq 123456789, win 64240, options [...], length 0 (retransmit)
```
Sam R.: conntrack exhausted on some nodes (conntrack_count ~ 65530).
Priya S.: I'm going to temporarily add more NAT ephemeral ranges and enable conntrack tuning on the eu-west-2 NAT gateway. Pushing change in 2m. Will also flip DNS resolver to the regional cache to avoid interzone DNS.
Maya L.: good. Priya, coordinate with eng-infra; notify CS about potential customer impact. Sam, keep packet captures. Chen, start collecting per-az packet loss graphs and TLS handshake histograms.
Chen W.: I'm collecting per-flow metrics. Quick note: we see a cluster of retries when flows cross azb->azc (inter-AZ routing). Could be asymmetric routing causing drop/ECN behavior.
Luis G.: CS-Liaison, heads up: streaming customers might see stalls. which tenants hit worst?
CS-Liaison: Early list from logs: AcmeMedia (streaming edge), Voxly, BetaPlay. All had increased reconnects ~12:03-12:12 UTC. I'm preparing a short status note.
Priya S.: rolling NAT ephemeral increase now:
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000
# update nat gateway ephemeral port pool + restart agent
```
Priya S.: also toggled DNS resolver to regional cache for eu-west-2: changed /etc/resolv.conf via config rollout (no restart).
Maya L.: any immediate change in p99 after NAT bump?
Sam R.: small improvement: p95 down to 420ms, p99 now ~1.1s. streaming stalls reduced but still present for a subset. Retransmits down ~40%.
Chen W.: packet loss reduced to 0.12% after NAT changes, but TLS handshake tail still elevated in azc. Still observing SYN->ACK path asymmetry for some flows.
Maya L.: Ok, mitigation stage 1 looks good. Next: try route fix to avoid the problem path. Can we fail traffic to azb->azc via an alternate interzone path?
Priya S.: I can add a temporary routing policy to prefer azb->azd for egress. Rolling now to a small percentage (10%) as canary.
Priya S.: routing canary applied for 10% of flows. Monitoring.
Sam R.: canary looks clean so far, no increase in retransmits on those. p99 for canary ~450ms.
Luis G.: CS-Liaison, send out a short blurb: we've applied mitigations (NAT tuning + DNS regional cache) and are routing a subset away from the problematic path; some customers may have experienced brief stalls but service is improving.
CS-Liaison: Draft sent to Eng review: "We observed elevated streaming stalls in eu-west-2 due to cross-AZ networking issues; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll update in 30m or sooner."
Maya L.: Paging: next on-call @Chen W. I'm handing off. Chen, do you want me to stay on watch?
Chen W.: I'll take over. @Maya L. please handoff notes: what changed, current metrics, customer list.
Maya L.: Handoff: 1) NAT ephemeral increase + conntrack increased. 2) regional DNS cache enabled. 3) 10% routing canary to avoid azc path. 4) p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.1s (improving), packet loss ~0.12%. Impacted tenants: AcmeMedia, Voxly, BetaPlay. Logs & pcaps in /var/tmp/incidents/2149876543.
Chen W.: ack taking over. I'll escalate to network infra if we see any regression.
Priya S.: will keep routing canary at 10% and be ready to scale to 50% if metrics hold.
Sam R.: collecting final captures and tails. leaving a background job to upload aggregated traces to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/2149876543/
Luis G.: thanks team. CS-Liaison will send an update to customers. any followups for postmortem?
Maya L.: please add: timeline of events, root cause hypothesis (inter-AZ route causing packet loss + conntrack exhaustion), mitigations applied, follow-up actions (make NAT pools adaptive, review interzone routing, expand DNS regional caching, add alarm for conntrack high-water).
CS-Liaison: update sent to customers at 12:35 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to: MONITORED. severity: SEV3 -> MONITOR.
Chen W.: closing handoff. I'll keep monitor until metrics stable for 1h.
CS-Liaison: customers confirming improvements. AcmeMedia reported "latency spike reduced, streams recovered".
Maya L.: thanks all. filing a postmortem ticket and assigning owners for follow-ups.
Chen W.: last note: saved packet captures and conntrack snapshots in the incident folder.
Priya S.: will revert any temporary tuning after 2h if stable; will schedule infra change to increase conntrack in the longer term.
Sam R.: final p99 at 12:58 UTC ~320ms. looks good.
CS-Liaison: will keep customers updated.
Maya L.: closing thread from my side. :white_check_mark:
